case_definition.admission_observation: Telemetry anomaly detected for vehicle VF8VNF_0006: battery_soc reported negative out-of-bound values.

initial_evidence.summary: Telemetry anomaly detected for vehicle VF8VNF_0006: battery_soc reported negative out-of-bound values.

ground_truth.ground_truth_cause: BMS sensor glitch or telemetry pipeline corruption causing negative SOC values (battery_soc < 0).

hypothesis.claim: The recent BMS firmware update (v2.3.1) introduced a sensor/glitch bug that caused the SOC estimator to output negative values, violating the defined 0-100% range.
hypothesis.technical_summary: Telemetry fetch shows repeated negative SOC values, which directly breach the schema contract requiring SOC >= 0. A recent BMS firmware deployment aligns temporally with the onset of the anomaly. No other upstream changes or sensor hardware issues are indicated. Data quality checks flag a range violation for the same metric. The convergence of these pieces points to a firmware-induced sensor/glitch rather than physical degradation.
